Subject: Re: Action ledger: RN-quantization rollout window (B)

Agree to own B. Quick technical note: the rollout window needs a fallback policy — for some models quantized kernels increase tail latency on NVLink setups. Proposed approach: staged canary on Dedicated pool 2 (low-traffic), 48h metrics gate (latency + p99 token cost) then widen to pool 1. If gate fails, automatic fallback to full-precision variant for traffic >5 RPS/customer.

OWNER: Vivek Kulkarni / CONFIRMED BY: Infra + Runtime / BLOCKERS: need a smoke test harness and pre-rollout perf baseline (I can produce by 2027-05-25 but final metric gating needs infra support) / ETA: canary start 2027-05-26 09:00 PDT

Note: this expands the rollout timeline by ~24h but reduces risk of customer impact. Karthik — product needs to sign off on the fallback rule.

-Vivek
